authorInfo.bio: John Stuart Mill (1806–1873) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Socialism" by John Stuart Mill is a philosophical treatise that reflects on social and economic structures written in the late 19th century. In this work, Mill explores the implications and critiques of socialism, addressing how various systems of property and social organization can impact the public good and the welfare of the working class.
